PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
 
Senior Operations Manager with 11 years of experience in Banking Operations, specializing in Card Operations, Fraud Operations, Check 
Processing & Reconciliation, and Risk & AML/KYC Compliance. Proven expertise in end-to-end Debit, Credit and Commercial Card 
lifecycles, fraud detection and investigation, dispute management, and high-volume check processing and reconciliation. Strong background 
in operational risk management, AML/KYC and regulatory compliance, audit readiness and control governance aligned with banking 
standards. Experienced in leading large-scale operations (120+ FTE), driving service delivery excellence, and managing SLA/KPI 
performance across global teams. Demonstrated success in process optimization, automation initiatives, UAT and system implementations, 
reconciliation controls, and continuous improvement programs.
